entries.name: Aberrant Mind

completeOriginalObject.name: Aberrant Mind
completeOriginalObject.description: Your mind has been touched by alien intelligence.
completeOriginalObject.effect: You can communicate telepathically with aberrations and have resistance to psychic damage.

NEW while conscious, initiate one two-way telepathic conversation with one actual Aberration you perceive within60ft and line of effect. A brief message uses the ordinary free communication allowance on your own regular turn; an invited willing recipient may reply briefly without Action, including off-turn, without gaining another action. Silence/Deafened alone does not block purely mental speech, but Unconscious or explicit telepathy/mental-communication protection does. One channel at a time, no relay or shared senses. completeOriginalObject.name: Acrobatic Mastery
completeOriginalObject.description: Disciplined balance turns a failed Acrobatics attempt into a practiced recovery.
completeOriginalObject.effect: When you fail a Dexterity (Acrobatics) check, reroll it. You must use the new result. You regain this use after a long rest.

If another feature can alter a die, declare an eligible sequence before resolving it; this feat cannot reroll its own reroll, and no earlier result can be restored merely because the new result is worse. A purely Strength (Athletics) check does not qualify.

NEW: the identity can be invented or real, but the chosen presentation must be physically possible with your actual appearance, voice, clothing, languages, knowledge and any separately active disguise or magic. Recheck the exit after interruptions; if traversal becomes impossible before entry, stay outside and spend the committed use. Do not willingly start a traversal without a complete legal route. Other creatures may make normal opportunity attacks. This does not shove or phase through a creature.

NEW one Lucky intervention per underlying roll event even if another rule later rerolls it. Resolve Elven Accuracy on initial eligible dice first, then Lucky; Elven Accuracy cannot reroll the added Lucky die. completeOriginalObject.name: Target Mark
completeOriginalObject.description: Wisdom 14+ and Ranged support the listed mark that increases damage taken by the target.
completeOriginalObject.effect: As a bonus action, mark a creature you can see within weapon range for 1 minute. The first attack by each ally against it gains +1 to hit. You may maintain only one mark and regain this use after a short rest.
completeOriginalObject.legacyEffect: Mark target to take 10% more dmg

exactAcquisitionDescriptor.operativeInterpretation: KEEP actual printed predicates as completed by the operative procedure and FS-01/02; normalized tree is supporting navigation, not substitute authority.
exactAcquisitionDescriptor.completeControllingOperativeProcedure:
Bonus Action, once per short rest: while holding an actual usable weapon, choose a creature you can see within its current melee reach or printed maximum ranged range, with line of effect. A thrown weapon uses its actual range; ordinary long-range disadvantages remain. Record the chosen weapon only to establish activation range; stowing it later does not end the mark. For1minute, the first attack against the marked creature by each creature currently allied to you, including yourself, gains+1 to hit. This is once per ally identity for the entire mark, not per turn, and is consumed by that attack even if it misses. You are an eligible ally for your own mark. A creature's later alliance change does not reset its used identity; a newly arriving genuine ally can use its own first attack. Only one mark per owner; replacement, owner death or expiry ends the old record. NEW owner incapacitation does not end an existing mark. No continuous range/tether after activation and no vision/targeting permission is granted. Multiple marks never give more than+1 to the same attack; all applicable unspent first-attack entitlements for that attacker consume on that first event.
SOURCE SCOPE CORRECTION: “allies” includes the feat owner unless the actual clause says “other.” The owner must still meet the same hearing/perception, range, willing-target and action/resource predicates. No second body, observer or extra action is created by self-eligibility. This sentence supersedes any narrower owner-exclusion in the submitted proposal, not the preserved original.
NEW weapon-range completion: at activation use an actually held, usable weapon’s current reach or printed ranged range, including a melee weapon’s reach; a ranged weapon is not mandatory. Long range does not remove its ordinary disadvantage. Marking does not grant an attack, visibility or line of effect. The mark’s +1 applies to each qualifying ally’s first attack against that target, including the owner’s. Multiple marks of this same feat give one+1 and consume all applicable first-attack entitlements on that event.

completeOriginalObject.name: Tracker
completeOriginalObject.description: You can follow tracks across any terrain.
completeOriginalObject.effect: You can track creatures across any surface, including water and air. You can determine the age, size, and condition of tracks.

exactAcquisitionDescriptor.operativeInterpretation: KEEP actual printed predicates as completed by the operative procedure and FS-01/02; normalized tree is supporting navigation, not substitute authority.
exactAcquisitionDescriptor.completeControllingOperativeProcedure: The source expressly allows tracking over water and air. NEW proposed completion preserves a real exceptional benefit: from an actual known starting trail or witnessed passage, you can perceive faint physical-passage impressions of that same creature's continuous route within60feet of your position for up to24elapsed hours after passage, including its waterborne or airborne segments. This is a feat-local extraordinary trail sense, not free knowledge of every nearby creature. Spend one active minute examining a segment and make Wisdom (Survival) DC15, increased by5 when the trail is more than12hours old and by5 where multiple actual trails are heavily intermingled; an exact concealing source may expressly block or modify this sensing. On success follow the actual local direction and learn the passage's approximate age, creature size and evident physical condition such as limping or bleeding. No exact current HP, identity, destination, invisible present location, future path or unobserved intent is revealed. You still need a physically possible way to traverse the route, time at your legal tracking pace and a new real examination when a junction or lost segment creates uncertainty. Teleportation supplies no traversed intervening path; track ends at departure and resumes only after separately finding the arrival trail. No new plane/soul/cosmological mechanism is inferred. Failed unchanged examination cannot be rerolled without changed access, evidence or method. This exceptional-sense choice needs explicit GPT review against mundane tracking and divination.

exactAcquisitionDescriptor.completeControllingOperativeProcedure: The current source names two bonus effects without defining either. NEW complete proposal for discussion: once per completed long rest, after you personally finish a legal successful forage task yielding actual edible material, designate at most your current PB ordinary portions from that finite yield. Spend 30 active minutes with an actual cooking kit, safe heat and water if the food needs them to prepare those portions. No extra food, ingredients or Supply are created; record the original forage batch and its real quantities. Each designated portion has exactly two proposed riders: (1) Trail-ready preparation pauses its ordinary unprotected spoilage clock for the next six elapsed hours while kept clean in an appropriate container, after which its prior age resumes; breach or contamination ends this protection and other preservation does not add the intervals. (2) The eater may add +1 to one actual Constitution save against ordinary foodborne illness or food poisoning within one elapsed hour after fully consuming the portion, declaring before that roll. This does not work against magical poison, weapon poison, existing illness or non-food hazards. Record one recipient entitlement per completed long rest across all Wilderness Chefs; consuming another portion neither refreshes nor stacks it. Pay the cook's use at preparation start, even if interrupted. A poisoned or unsafe ingredient is not made edible; no other cooked recipe, Chef-serving or Feast effect is added to the same physical portion. These two riders are deliberately proposed new text, not recovered source or an interpretation of the legacy +10%.

On failure halve that target's current applicable movement Speeds until the end of your next original regular turn; do not stack same-family halves. NEW: the rider can qualify when the feat's advantage was canceled, because the selected paid mode still applied. The creature must possess relevant anatomy; no taxonomy or immunity is rewritten. exactAcquisitionDescriptor.completeControllingOperativeProcedure:
## Blood Ritual — Magic; Constitution13+ and character level4+

Perform a ten-minute ritual once per completed long rest. Commit the use at ritual start. Snapshot your character level, PB and selected targets then: yourself plus up to PB **other** willing allies. Each ally must remain within10ft throughout, witness the ritual and voluntarily contribute a drop of blood. There is no normal-HP payment. No substitutions are allowed after starting.

At completion, offer yourself `2 × snapshotted character level` temporary HP with default lifetime. Each continuously eligible selected ally receives `snapshotted character level` temporary HP for one elapsed hour. A departed/ineligible ally loses only its own benefit. Your interruption fails the whole unfinished ritual and the use remains spent until a real rest resets it.

You also gain advantage on your next actual saving throw against an effect explicitly classified as a curse or disease. This rider is independent of the shield: rejection, replacement or depletion of temporary HP does not remove it. It ends when you roll that qualifying save or complete your next long rest, whichever is first. Consume it on the roll even if advantage cancels disadvantage or the save fails. It neither cures nor waives Oracle's intrinsic Curse and grants no oath or transformation.

If completion is strictly before a long-rest endpoint, the self shield/rider expire at that rest normally. At an exact tied completion, resolve old rest expirations, advance the epoch/reset resources, finalize Chef if applicable, then complete the tied ritual; its new shield/rider belong to the new epoch. Its already-committed start use is never retroactively refunded.

**NEW:** PB ally cap, presence/willingness details, use timing and independent save-rider deadline. Self/ally amounts and the ally's hour follow the reconciled source.

Require actual Smith’s-tools/Blacksmithing proficiency and either actual spellcasting ability or actual Engineering proficiency. At completion of your beneficial Long Rest, you may touch one functional weapon or armor suit for which you have a genuine personal lead-crafter receipt and place one infusion on it for24elapsed hours. NEW: your own qualifying transformative manufacture counts, but buying, repairing or merely assisting does not. One active infusion per owner; replacing it ends the old one. One infusion slot per body across all owners; a new consensual infusion replaces the existing one rather than adding. The creature holding/wearing it must actually allow the accessible operation; no remote overwrite.

Choose one NEW closed minor property: a weapon adds+1fire to each actual hit made with it; an armor suit gains+1AC in equipment.defense-enhancement; or either body grants resistance to one chosen acid,cold,fire,lightning or thunder damage type while actually properly worn as armor or wielded as a functional weapon. The+1fire is a flat component of the same hit, not critical-doubled or an independent proc; it does not enhance spells merely cast while holding the weapon. Resistances do not double with same-type resistance. The magical infusion suspends while Broken, suppressed, melded or otherwise unusable, with its original clock running; repair/unsuppression can resume the remaining time but cannot refresh it. It is magical item functionality, not a spell, concentration or Counterspell target. The feat grants no Relic item or additional Relic property: any actual Relic work still requires its specifically authorized design, rare materials, forge and access, beyond this closed menu.

While you actually wear/wield your own currently active, usable infused item, gain+2 to actual Blacksmithing repair checks on that same item. Once per Short Rest you may reroll one failed actual Craft check on that same item under the shared reroll timing while this wear/wield eligibility holds. NEW: Craft here includes otherwise authorized Blacksmithing creation/alteration/repair checks actually acting on that item, not unrelated Engineering or research. Physical work still needs the source’s real tools/position and safe access; wearing a suit during a repair is not automatically feasible. A Broken item supplies neither bonus nor reroll because it cannot be functionally worn/wielded for the infusion. The reroll expends only this allowance, pays no duplicate batch cost, and never resurrects an ineligible work order.

While conscious and actually holding a weapon in a legal grip, you cannot be involuntarily disarmed of that weapon. NEW: resolve an otherwise valid disarm attempt normally to determine whether it would succeed, then keep the weapon and deal1d4bludgeoning directly to that initiating attacker instead, subject to its ordinary defenses. A failed attempt deals nothing. It does not prevent voluntary release, destruction/Broken state, severed anatomy, a legal whole-body movement or losing consciousness, and does not protect unrelated held objects merely because they are called important. You may wield an actually profiled weapon one size category larger without the penalty imposed solely by that size mismatch; no extra size/damage/reach/hands/proficiency is created. This and Giant Strength confer the same one-category permission, not two categories.

Until your next original regular-turn start, opportunity attacks against you have disadvantage. NEW: count voluntary/forced movement, carried movement and actual teleport displacement; in-place rotation is0. Once displacement exceeds5feet, the damage opportunity is lost for this activation even if you return; the opportunity-attack disadvantage persists for its original duration. A caltrop field remains physically present and hazardous after an entry or successful save. currentCompleteContract.completeOperativeProcedure:

Availability and assembly are real: obtain a genuinely prepared kit from an actual provider, or spend30active minutes with suitable mechanical tools and the same actual parts, DC12 INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves’-tools, using Core binary task outcome. Failure consumes time and expendable cord/filling, retaining only real recoverable frame/metal parts; no free complete kit. The new reference prices are complete kit references, not added again to their component prices. No ordinary Rune or Tinkering formula is silently renamed one of these three options.

Place one held/accessible prepared kit in a real stable unoccupied5-foot ground square within5feet. Normally this feat procedure takes an Action; once per Short Rest for each of the three types, you may use a Bonus Action instead, spending that type’s separate quick-placement allowance. NEW one armed trap of each type per setter; a new enhanced trap of that type cannot arm until the old trap has actually been safely disarmed, discharged, collected or destroyed through a lawful physical event. Merely arming a replacement or changing custody cannot remotely disable an existing trap. Ordinary unenhanced caltrop placements retain their own item rule. It arms at your next original regular-turn start, or after six elapsed seconds outside initiative, preserving the same deadline across mode changes. SnapshotDC8+PB+INT modifier at placement. For snare and charge, the first actual grounded creature entering from outside, including an ally, forced movement or teleport arrival, triggers once; an existing occupant, flying above it, or replayed movement is not another entry. The target makesDEXsave against the storedDC. On failure: snare givesStunned until the target’s next regular-turn end; charge deals2d6fire in that same event with no ongoing Burn; caltrop field uses the reviewed ordinary caltrop failure effect of1piercing, stopping remaining movement that turn and-10walkingSpeed until1HPhealing or an Action removes the caltrop. The caltrop slow is one shared same-area effect, not a new Slow condition, and moving at halfSpeed still avoids its save as under its actual item rule. Success avoids the trap’s feat effect. NEW snare and charge discharge after that first eligible trigger regardless of result; surviving actual metal/body can be recovered, but rearming requires a new prepared kit procedure and actual expendables. A caltrop field remains physically present and hazardous after an entry or successful save. Each actual new entry follows its stored feat DC and ordinary caltrop procedure, including half-Speed avoidance; an unchanged standing position is not another entry. Preserve all actual placed, embedded, removed and recovered pieces; no embedded piece exists simultaneously in the field or returns twice. Loss of actual coverage or stock can reduce the hazard only through the physical source record, not automatic first-trigger discharge. The field continues occupying the setter’s one enhanced-caltrop allowance until it is physically cleared. A charge consumes its filling; this does not duplicate its frame. Placement speed does not shorten preparation or refill after transfer.

The exposed snare/charge assembly isAC15/5HP; caltrops retain their actual ordinary physical pieces. An Action with safe reach disarms your own accessible trap. Another creature that has detected it can spend an Action with actual appropriate tools onDCequal to storedDC using INT/Engineering or DEX/thieves’-tools; failure triggers it only if that actual manipulation enters its working trigger, not arbitrarily against a remote observer. Hidden placement requires actual concealment: record one real setter DEX/Stealth check opposed by the actual search/passive-perception procedure, without granting invisibility. Once visible, ordinary physical removal/destruction still follows actual reach/safety and object rules. A snare/charge whose necessary mechanism is moved, Broken or disconnected becomes disarmed and needs real rearming; a cover prevents its trigger only while physically effective. Moving or covering some caltrops does not magically remove the remainder. NEW safe collection of an accessible unoccupied caltrop square requires one active minute with actual hands, tools/protection as necessary and a real receiver; retain the count and condition of the pieces actually collected. Unsafe manipulation follows the actual hazard. Reconstruction never duplicates stock or the type’s spent quick-placement use.

You have advantage on actual checks to spot hidden traps or tunnel evidence within30feet, not automatic sight through walls or knowledge that a tunnel exists. On a real trigger of any trap you personally placed, after its immediate effect resolves and if you are still capable of taking a Reaction and can perceive the triggering creature within30feet, you may spend that Reaction to move up to half your current applicable Speed. Pay ordinary terrain/mode costs from this distinct movement budget, respect speed0/restraints and actual paths. This movement provokes no opportunity attack from that triggering creature; other creatures’ normal opportunity attacks remain. You may use real cover or a real prepared kill-zone at the destination, but the feat creates neither. One trigger event permits at most one Reaction; copies, already discharged traps and additional targets of one blast are not new triggers.
The snare’s Stunned application uses the existing source/target/encounter hard-denial eligibility and immunity ledger; rearming or changing trap IDs does not reset it. If barred, no substitute damage or condition is awarded. The charge’s2d6fire is immediate damage, not a separate Burn condition. For assembly, resolve Core task degrees/natural shifts and collapse to success/failure; the basic-dismantling no-natural-shift exception does not apply. exactAcquisitionDescriptor.completeControllingOperativeProcedure: Require Constitution 15 and actually owned Necrotic Affinity or Dark Fortitude, using their exact feat IDs. Gain resistance to necrotic and poison damage. NEW delayed-recovery procedure: once per completed long rest, after an actual positive-to-zero damage/loss event finishes its Core Instant Death, Wound and death processing and leaves you living at zero, you may commit the use to that real dying/Stable episode without an Action or Reaction. NEW this trigger choice is permitted despite Unconscious/Incapacitated caused by this just-completed drop to0; it does not require an impossible conscious Reaction. No earlier corpse, unrelated historical0HP episode or lethal event qualifies. Record a recovery deadline at the start of your next original regular turn, preserving its virtual marker if initiative changes. At that deadline, before the normal death save, if you are still living at zero in that same episode, attempt direct state recovery to 1 HP. Broad HP-gain prohibition blocks the point; it does not create stability or refund the use. Earlier positive healing closes the pending episode and cancels this later recovery without reducing HP; actual death cancels it and cannot be reversed. On actual successful recovery, NEW: gain a one-elapsed-minute rider adding 2 necrotic damage once to each genuine personally owned damaging attack/spell/feature event, before target defenses. Apply it once to a shared area roll/event, with each target resolving its own defenses; a mixed-type packet does not gain it per component. Fixed damage and actual ongoing source ticks can qualify, but copied/reflected damage, another creature's actions and newly invented split packets do not. The flat +2 is not doubled by critical hits. It is this feat's damage component, not ordinary spell damage for Lifeleech, and creates no new spell, hit, payment, resource event or damage root; it cannot recursively trigger itself. Direct recovery does not remove Wounds, Prone or an independent cause of Unconsciousness. It ends on its deadline or your actual death and does not stack with itself. Missing this delayed recovery or being killed before it never becomes a later corpse wake-up.
